=== FINAL DECISIVE CHECKS ===
[deps] 609 packages; next=  "version": "15.5.27",
[missing data files]
  MISSING: assets/data/wachstum-recent.csv
  MISSING: assets/data/bip-recent.csv
  MISSING: assets/data/einwohner.csv
[routes on running server]
  /            -> HTTP 500
  /klima       -> HTTP 500
  /energie     -> HTTP 500
  /mobilitaet  -> HTTP 500
  /gebaeude    -> HTTP 500

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== FINAL DECISIVE CHECKS ==="; echo "[deps] $(ls node_modules | wc -l) packages; next=$(cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '\"version\"' | head -1)"; echo "[missing data files]"; for f in wachstum-recent.csv bip-recent.csv einwohner.csv; do test -f assets/data/$f || echo "  MISSING: assets/data/$f"; done; echo "[routes on running server]"; for p in / /klima /energie /mobilitaet /gebaeude; do printf "  %-12s -> HTTP %s\n" "$p" "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 60 http://localhost:3000$p)"; done
